note: net flow = change in BTC held x price; accumulates from first successful run. Every US spot issuer has been checked; those absent publish no primary machine-readable daily coin count and the reason is recorded per ticker

no_primary_source.GBTC: Grayscale Bitcoin Trust ETF: product page is script-rendered and rate-limits automated requests; no public data endpoint found
no_primary_source.BTC: Grayscale Bitcoin Mini Trust: same page technology and limits as GBTC
no_primary_source.FBTC: Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund: no machine-readable daily holdings file published; product pages are script-rendered
no_primary_source.BTCO: Invesco Galaxy Bitcoin ETF: quarterly PDF fact sheet only; no daily quantity endpoint
no_primary_source.EZBC: Franklin Bitcoin ETF: product pages are a client-side application; no holdings file served to a plain request
no_primary_source.BRRR: CoinShares Bitcoin ETF: same, no machine-readable daily holdings file found
no_primary_source.BTCW: WisdomTree Bitcoin Fund: page publishes weights, NAV and shares outstanding but no coin quantity; deriving coins from assets divided by price would be an estimate, not a disclosure, so it is not done here

coverage.note: coverage is the sum of the latest disclosure from each covered issuer; it is not total spot-ETF holdings
